title: Galois compositum and injective restriction
statement: Let $k\subseteq E$ be a field extension and let $K,F$ be subfields of $E$ containing $k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Assume $K/k$ is finite Galois: finite-dimensional, normal and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Assume $K\vee F=E$, where $K\vee F$ is the smallest subfield of $E$ containing both $K$ and $F$. Then $E/F$ is Galois (normal and separable algebraic). Every $F$-algebra automorphism of $E$ preserves $K$, and restriction is an injective group homomorphism $\operatorname{Aut}_F(E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Aut}_k(K)$. A field extension is normal here when the minimal polynomial of every element splits into linear factors over the larger field; a group of field automorphisms has composition as its multiplication.
